decisions.choice: Praise Yah: the call Hallelu-yah
decisions.reason: The psalm opens and closes (verse 21) with Hallelu-yah, "praise Yah". Yah is the short form of the divine name (Exodus 15:2), rendered like the full name, with Yah as the alternative. Verses 3 and 4 use the short form too.

decisions.choice: the opening of Psalms 113 and 134
decisions.reason: The first lines echo 113:1 ("Praise, servants of the LORD, praise the name of the LORD") and 134:1, which also calls on the LORD's servants who stand in his house. Much of this psalm gathers lines from other parts of Scripture.

decisions.choice: servants of the LORD: those who serve at his house
alternatives: all Israel as the LORD's servants
decisions.reason: Verse 2 places them in the temple and its courts: the priests and Levites first, but verses 19-20 widen the call to all Israel and all who fear the LORD.

decisions.choice: give him praise (B); praise him (R)
decisions.reason: The third "praise" has no object in the Hebrew; Balanced and Readable supply "him", the LORD just named.

decisions.choice: "Louez le SEIGNEUR", with "Yah" under the divine-name setting, for Hallelu-yah
decisions.reason: The terms note sets this form for the call Hallelu-yah: it says what the call means, and readers who choose the name see "Louez Yah". "Alléluia", the familiar French form, would keep the sound but hide the meaning.

decisions.choice: "Msifuni BWANA" (Praise the LORD), with "Yah" under the name setting, for Hallelu Yah
decisions.reason: Hallelu Yah is a command to a group: "praise Yah". Swahili says it with the plural command "Msifuni", so the reader hears what it means; the short name Yah is shown as BWANA, with "Yah" as the setting's alternative.

decisions.choice: Alaben / Alabad al SEÑOR, with Yah as the alternative
decisions.reason: The Hebrew Hallelu-yah is a plural command, "praise Yah". Spanish says it in words at every level, with the plural_you setting on the verb ("Alaben" or "Alabad") and the divine_name setting offering "a Yah". "Aleluya" would keep the sound but hide the call to praise.

decisions.choice: "Hãy ca ngợi CHÚA" for Hallelu-yah, with "Gia" as the divine_name alternative
decisions.reason: The call means "Praise Yah" (see the meaning decision). The terms note translates it at every level, so Vietnamese readers hear what is said, with the short name Yah behind the setting, as the English does.

decisions.choice: Hallelu Yah is "{{divine_name:주|야}}를 찬양하여라" at every level, as the terms note
decisions.reason: The call is translated, so the reader hears what it says; the short name Yah is the span's alternative. "찬양하다" is the terms note's word for hallel, kept apart from "송축하다" (bless) in verses 19-21.

decisions.choice: Aleluia! Louvem ..., servos do SENHOR (L, B); Louvem o SENHOR! (R)
decisions.reason: The opening echoes 113:1 and 134:1 (m2), so it keeps their Portuguese: "Aleluia" at Literal and Balanced and "Louvem o SENHOR!" with "Iá" at Readable, as the book does for hallelu-yah, and the plural "Louvem", with "vocês". In verse 3 the same call stands inside the sentence ("Aleluia, pois o SENHOR é bom"), and verse 4 has the short name alone, "o SENHOR" with "Iá" as the alternative, as in 68:5.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of Psalm 135.
alternatives: spans like the English ones (from verse 1)
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic.

decisions.choice: "Praise Yah" (Hallelu-yah), which the English translates, as "እግዚአብሔርን (alternative ያህን) አመስግኑ" with "ያህን" as the alternative; here and in verses 3 and 21
alternatives: "ሃሌ ሉያ", the form the terms list keeps for a transliterated Hallelujah
decisions.reason: The English translates the call here, so the Amharic does too, in the terms list's wording for a translated Hallelujah; the alternative gives the short form Yah that the Hebrew has (meaning decision m1), as the English span does and as Psalm 122:4 and 130:3.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:प्रभु|याह}} की स्तुति करो" for Hallelu-Yah; no deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: The call Hallelu-yah (meaning m1) is translated, with the short name Yah under the divine_name setting, as the poetry note's table has it; "हल्लेलूयाह" is kept for where the English keeps the word. Devanagari has no capital letters, so the deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change: God spoken of takes the honorific plural ("उनकी").

decisions.choice: "दासो" (L, B); "सेवा करनेवाले" (R)
decisions.reason: ʿeved is "दास" as in 134:1; Readable says what the servants do, as the English does (meaning m3).

decisions.choice: Хвалите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ях}}
decisions.reason: Hallelu-yah (m1) in the form the poetry note settles for every level: the default reads ГОСПОДА like the English "the LORD", and the divine_name setting gives the short name Ях. Аллилуйя is kept for the places where the English keeps "Hallelujah" as a word.

decisions.choice: рабы ГОСПОДА
decisions.reason: 'Avdei YHWH, the LORD's servants at his house (m3): раб at every level, as the poetry note settles; Readable turns it into a verb, служит.

decisions.choice: Hallelu-yah "{{divine_name:主|ヤハ}}を賛美せよ" (L, B), "…賛美しよう" (R); hallelu "賛美せよ" (L, B), "賛美しよう" (R); 'avdei YHWH "DNのしもべたち" (L, B), "DNに仕える人たち" (R)

uk.R: Ви стоїте в домі {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, на подвірʼях храму нашого Бога.

decisions.choice: stand: serve
decisions.reason: To stand before the LORD is the posture of those who serve him, as the Levites were set apart "to stand before the LORD to serve him" (Deuteronomy 10:8).

decisions.choice: courts: the open courtyards around the temple
decisions.reason: The courts (chatserot) were the walled open spaces around the temple building, where the worshipers gathered (84:3; 100:4).

decisions.choice: temple
decisions.reason: Readable says "temple" for the second "house", the building the courtyards surround.

decisions.choice: L ends 135:1 with 、 and 135:2 restates the address "…立つ者たちよ", where the English relative clause runs on
decisions.reason: Japanese cannot hang a relative clause after the vocative; each verse keeps its own content. Standing is serving (m1).

records.literal_gloss: Praise Yah, for good [is] YHWH; sing praises to his name, for [it is] pleasant.

en.L: Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}, for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] good; sing praises to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name, for [it is] pleasant.
en.B: Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}, for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is good; make music to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name, for that is a delight.
en.R: Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}, because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is good. Sing praise to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name, because singing to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} is a joy.

fr.L: Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}}, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est] bon ; chantez {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom, car [c’est] agréable.
fr.B: Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}}, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est bon ; jouez pour {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom, car c’est un bonheur.
fr.R: Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}}, parce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est bon. Chantez pour {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom, parce que c’est une joie de chanter pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.

sw.L: Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}, kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] mwema; imbeni sifa kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, kwa maana [ni] kupendeza.
sw.B: Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}, kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mwema; pigeni muziki kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, kwa maana hilo ni furaha.
sw.R: Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}, kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mwema. Imbeni sifa kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, kwa sababu kumwimbia ni furaha.

es.L: ¡{{plural_you:Alaben|Alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yah}}, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} [es] bueno! {{plural_you:Canten|Cantad}} alabanzas a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre, porque [es] agradable.
es.B: ¡{{plural_you:Alaben|Alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yah}}, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es bueno! {{plural_you:Hagan|Haced}} música a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre, porque eso es una delicia.
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Alaben|Alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yah}}, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es bueno! {{plural_you:Canten|Cantad}} alabanzas a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre, porque cantarle a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es una alegría.

vi.L: Hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}}, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là] tốt lành; hãy hát ca ngợi danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, vì [điều đó thật] êm dịu.
vi.B: Hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}}, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là tốt lành; hãy đàn hát cho danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, vì đó là điều vui thích.
vi.R: Hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}}, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là tốt lành. Hãy hát ca ngợi danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, vì hát cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là niềm vui.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야}}를 찬양하여라, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 선하시기 때문이다. 그분의 이름을 노래하여라, [그것이] 즐겁기 때문이다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야}}를 찬양하여라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 선하시다. 그분의 이름에 노래로 찬양을 드려라. 그것은 기쁨이다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야}}를 찬양하여라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 좋으신 분이시다. 그분의 이름을 노래하여라. 그분께 노래하는 것은 기쁜 일이다.

pt.L: Aleluia, pois {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} [é] bom; cantem louvores ao {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome, pois [é] agradável.
pt.B: Aleluia, pois {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} é bom; toquem música para o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome, porque isso é uma alegria.
pt.R: Louvem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Iá}}, porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} é bom. Cantem louvores ao {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome, porque cantar para {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} é uma alegria.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህን}} አመስግኑ፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} መልካም ነውና፤ ለስሙ ዘምሩ፤ ደስ የሚያሰኝ ነውና።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህን}} አመስግኑ፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} መልካም ነውና፤ ለስሙ ዘምሩ፤ ይህ ደስ የሚያሰኝ ነውና።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህን}} አመስግኑ፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} መልካም ነውና። ለስሙ የምስጋና መዝሙር ዘምሩ፤ ለእርሱ መዘመር ደስ ያሰኛልና።

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याह}} की स्तुति करो, क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} भले [हैं]; उनके नाम का भजन गाओ, क्योंकि [वह] मनोहर [है]।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याह}} की स्तुति करो, क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} भले हैं; उनके नाम के लिए संगीत बजाओ, क्योंकि यह आनंद की बात है।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याह}} की स्तुति करो, क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} भले हैं। उनके नाम की स्तुति के गीत गाओ, क्योंकि उनके लिए गाना आनंद की बात है।

ru.L: Хвалите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ях}}, ведь благ {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}; пойте имени {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}, ведь [это] приятно.
ru.B: Хвалите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ях}}, ведь {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} добр; играйте и пойте {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} имени, ведь это отрада.
ru.R: Хвалите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ях}}, потому что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} добр. Пойте хвалу {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} имени, потому что петь {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}} — радость.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハ}}を賛美せよ！{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は良い方だからだ。その名にほめ歌を歌え。それは快いからだ。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハ}}を賛美せよ！{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は良い方だ。その名にほめ歌を歌え。それは喜ばしいことだ。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハ}}を賛美しよう！{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は良い方だから。その方の名にほめ歌を歌おう。その方に歌うのは、楽しいことだから。

uk.L: Хваліть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яг}}, бо {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} — добрий; співайте хвалу {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} імені, бо [це] приємно.
uk.B: Хваліть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яг}}, бо {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} добрий; грайте {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} імені, бо це втіха.
uk.R: Хваліть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яг}}, бо {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} добрий. Співайте хвалу {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} імені, бо співати {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}} — радість.

decisions.choice: Yah: the short form of the divine name
decisions.reason: Yah is a shortened form of the name YHWH (as in Exodus 15:2 and in "Hallelu-yah"). It is rendered like the full name, with Yah as the alternative.

decisions.choice: it is pleasant: singing his praise is a delight
decisions.reason: "It" may be the act of singing praise, as in 147:1 ("for it is pleasant, praise is fitting"), or the LORD's name. The parallel with 147:1 favors the singing.

decisions.choice: sing praises: make music
decisions.reason: The verb (zamar) is to sing praise, often with instruments (33:2).

decisions.choice: that is a delight (B); singing to him is a joy (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what is pleasant (m2).

decisions.choice: zammeru "ほめ歌を歌え" (L, B), "ほめ歌を歌おう" (R); na'im "快い" (L), "喜ばしい" (B), "楽しい" (R)
decisions.reason: Psalter forms for zimmer; what is pleasant is read as singing his praise (m2, uncertain).

records.literal_gloss: For Jacob has chosen for himself Yah, Israel for his treasured possession.

en.L: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}} has chosen Jacob for {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}, Israel for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} treasured possession.
en.B: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}} chose Jacob to be {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own, Israel to be {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} special treasure.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yah}} chose the people of Jacob to belong to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. He chose Israel to be {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own treasure.

fr.L: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} a choisi Jacob pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, Israël pour {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} bien précieux.
fr.B: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} a choisi Jacob pour qu’il soit à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, Israël pour qu’il soit {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} trésor.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} a choisi le peuple de Jacob pour qu’il {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} appartienne. Il a choisi Israël pour être {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} trésor à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}} amemchagua Yakobo kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}, Israeli kuwa milki {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} ya thamani.
sw.B: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}} alimchagua Yakobo kuwa {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}, Israeli kuwa hazina {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} maalum.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}} aliwachagua watu wa Yakobo wawe mali {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. Aliwachagua Israeli wawe hazina {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}.

es.L: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yah}} ha escogido a Jacob para {{deity_pronoun:sí|Sí}}, a Israel como {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} posesión preciada.
es.B: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yah}} escogió a Jacob para que fuera {{deity_pronoun:suyo|Suyo}}, a Israel para que fuera {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} tesoro especial.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yah}} escogió al pueblo de Jacob para que le perteneciera a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. Escogió a Israel para que fuera {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propio tesoro.

vi.L: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}} đã chọn Gia-cốp cho chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, Y-sơ-ra-ên làm cơ nghiệp quý báu của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}} đã chọn Gia-cốp làm của riêng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, chọn Y-sơ-ra-ên làm báu vật đặc biệt của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}} đã chọn dân của Gia-cốp để họ thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Ngài chọn Y-sơ-ra-ên làm báu vật riêng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 참으로 {{divine_name:주|야}}께서 야곱을 자신을 위하여 택하셨고, 이스라엘을 자신의 소중한 소유로 [택하셨다].
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야}}께서 야곱을 택하여 그분의 것으로 삼으시고, 이스라엘을 그분의 특별한 보물로 삼으셨다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야}}께서 야곱의 자손을 택하여 그분께 속하게 하셨다. 이스라엘을 그분의 보물로 삼으셨다.

pt.L: Pois {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Iá}} escolheu Jacó para {{deity_pronoun:si|Si}}, Israel para {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} propriedade especial.
pt.B: Pois {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Iá}} escolheu Jacó para ser {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}}, Israel para ser o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} tesouro especial.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Iá}} escolheu o povo de Jacó para pertencer a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}. Ele escolheu Israel para ser o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} próprio tesouro.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህ}} ያዕቆብን ለራሱ፣ እስራኤልንም የግል ሀብቱ እንዲሆን መርጧልና።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህ}} ያዕቆብን የራሱ እንዲሆን፣ እስራኤልንም ውድ ሀብቱ እንዲሆን መርጧልና።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህ}} የያዕቆብን ዘሮች የእርሱ እንዲሆኑ መረጠ። እስራኤልን የራሱ ውድ ሀብት እንዲሆን መረጠ።

hi.L: क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याह}} ने याकूब को अपने लिए चुन लिया है, इस्राएल को अपना निज धन [होने के लिए]।
hi.B: क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याह}} ने याकूब को अपना होने के लिए चुना, इस्राएल को अपना विशेष धन होने के लिए।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याह}} ने याकूब के वंश को चुना कि वे उनके हों। उन्होंने इस्राएल को चुना कि वह उनका अपना ख़ज़ाना हो।

ru.L: Ведь {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ях}} избрал Иакова себе, Израиль — в особое достояние своё.
ru.B: Ведь {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ях}} избрал Иакова, чтобы он был {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} народом, Израиль — чтобы он был {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} особым сокровищем.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ях}} избрал народ Иакова, чтобы он принадлежал {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}}. Он избрал Израиль своим собственным сокровищем.

ja.L: まことに、{{divine_name:主|ヤハ}}はヤコブをご自分のためにお選びになった、イスラエルをご自分の宝として。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハ}}がヤコブを選んでご自分のものとし、イスラエルをご自分の特別な宝となさったからだ。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハ}}は、ヤコブの子孫をお選びになり、ご自分の民となさった。イスラエルを、ご自分の宝となさった。

uk.L: Бо {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яг}} вибрав собі Якова, Ізраїля — за свою скарбницю.
uk.B: Бо {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яг}} вибрав Якова, щоб він належав {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}}, Ізраїля — щоб був {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} особливим скарбом.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яг}} вибрав нащадків Якова, щоб вони належали {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}}. Він вибрав Ізраїля, щоб той був {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} власним скарбом.

decisions.choice: Yah: the short form of the divine name
decisions.reason: Yah is a shortened form of the name YHWH (as in Exodus 15:2 and in "Hallelu-yah"). It is rendered like the full name, with Yah as the alternative.

decisions.choice: treasured possession: a king's own treasure
decisions.reason: The word (segullah) is personal treasure, set apart as one's own (1 Chronicles 29:3). The LORD calls Israel his segullah at Sinai (Exodus 19:5) and in Deuteronomy 7:6.

decisions.choice: Jacob, Israel: the people named after their ancestor
decisions.reason: Jacob, renamed Israel (Genesis 32), is the father of the twelve tribes. Both names stand for the whole people.

decisions.choice: the people of Jacob
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that the nation is meant (m3).

decisions.choice: propriedade especial (L); tesouro especial (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word of Exodus 19:5 (m2), in that verse's Portuguese at each level.

decisions.choice: treasured possession (segullah) as "የግል ሀብት" (Literal), "ውድ ሀብት" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The words of Exodus 19:5 and Deuteronomy 7:6 on main for the same Hebrew word.

decisions.choice: "निज धन" (L), "विशेष धन" (B), "अपना ख़ज़ाना" (R)
decisions.reason: The treasured possession (segullah, meaning m2) keeps the Hindi of Exodus 19:5 at each level in this translation.

decisions.choice: особое достояние (L); особое сокровище (B, R)
decisions.reason: Segullah, a king's own treasure (m2), in the forms of Exodus 19:5 and Deuteronomy in this translation.

decisions.choice: bachar "お選びになった" (L, R), "選んで…となさった" (B); segullato "ご自分の宝" (L, R), "ご自分の特別な宝" (B)
decisions.reason: A king's own treasure (m2); お選びになる avoids 選ばれた, which reads passive.

source.text: כִּ֤י אֲנִ֣י יָ֭דַעְתִּי כִּי־גָד֣וֹל יְהוָ֑ה וַ֝אֲדֹנֵ֗ינוּ מִכָּל־אֱלֹהִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: For I know that great [is] YHWH, and our Lord [is] above all gods.

en.L: For I know that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] great, and our Lord [is] above all gods.
en.B: I am sure of it: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is great, and our Lord stands above all gods.
en.R: I know how great {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is. Our Lord is greater than any of the gods.

fr.L: Car moi, je sais que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est] grand, et notre Seigneur [est] au-dessus de tous les dieux.
fr.B: J’en suis certain : {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est grand, et notre Seigneur est au-dessus de tous les dieux.
fr.R: Je sais combien {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est grand. Notre Seigneur est plus grand que tous les dieux.

sw.L: Kwa maana mimi ninajua kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] mkuu, na Bwana wetu [yuko] juu ya miungu yote.
sw.B: Nina hakika nalo: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mkuu, na Bwana wetu yuko juu ya miungu yote.
sw.R: Ninajua jinsi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyo mkuu. Bwana wetu ni mkuu kuliko miungu yote.

es.L: Porque yo sé que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} [es] grande, y nuestro Señor [está] por encima de todos los dioses.
es.B: Estoy seguro de ello: {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es grande, y nuestro Señor está por encima de todos los dioses.
es.R: Yo sé lo grande que es {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Nuestro Señor es más grande que cualquiera de los dioses.

vi.L: Vì tôi biết rằng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là] vĩ đại, và Chúa chúng ta [ở] trên hết thảy các thần.
vi.B: Tôi biết chắc điều này: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} thật vĩ đại, và Chúa chúng ta cao trọng hơn hết thảy các thần.
vi.R: Tôi biết {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vĩ đại biết bao. Chúa chúng ta lớn hơn bất cứ thần nào.

ko.L: 참으로 나는 안다, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 위대하시고, 우리 주님은 모든 신들보다 위에 [계심을].
ko.B: 나는 확실히 안다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 위대하시고, 우리 주님은 모든 신들보다 높으시다.
ko.R: 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 얼마나 위대하신지 안다. 우리 주님은 어떤 신들보다도 더 크신 분이시다.

pt.L: Pois eu sei que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} [é] grande, e o nosso Senhor [está] acima de todos os deuses.
pt.B: Disso eu tenho certeza: {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} é grande, e o nosso Senhor está acima de todos os deuses.
pt.R: Eu sei como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} é grande. O nosso Senhor é maior do que todos os deuses.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ታላቅ እንደ ሆነ፣ ጌታችንም ከአማልክት ሁሉ በላይ እንደ ሆነ እኔ አውቃለሁና።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ታላቅ እንደ ሆነ፣ ጌታችንም ከአማልክት ሁሉ በላይ እንደ ሆነ በእርግጥ አውቃለሁ።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ምን ያህል ታላቅ እንደ ሆነ አውቃለሁ። ጌታችን ከአማልክት ሁሉ ይበልጣል።

hi.L: क्योंकि मैं जानता हूँ कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} महान [हैं], और हमारे प्रभु सब देवताओं से ऊपर [हैं]।
hi.B: मुझे इसका पूरा निश्चय है: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} महान हैं, और हमारे प्रभु सब देवताओं से ऊपर हैं।
hi.R: मैं जानता हूँ कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कितने महान हैं। हमारे प्रभु किसी भी देवता से बड़े हैं।

ru.L: Ведь я знаю, что велик {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, и Господь наш — выше всех богов.
ru.B: Я уверен в этом: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} велик, и наш Господь выше всех богов.
ru.R: Я знаю, как велик {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}. Наш Господь больше всех богов.

ja.L: まことに、わたしは知っている、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は大いなる方、わたしたちの主はすべての神々にまさる[方]であることを。
ja.B: わたしは確かに知っている。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は偉大な方、わたしたちの主は、すべての神々の上に立っておられる。
ja.R: わたしは知っている。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、なんと偉大な方だろう。わたしたちの主は、どの神々よりも偉大な方だ。

uk.L: Бо я знаю, що великий {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, і наш Господь — понад усіх богів.
uk.B: Я певен цього: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} великий, і наш Господь стоїть понад усіма богами.
uk.R: Я знаю, який великий {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}. Наш Господь більший за будь-яких богів.

decisions.choice: I know: a confession like Jethro's
decisions.reason: Jethro, hearing of the rescue from Egypt, said, "Now I know that the LORD is greater than all the gods" (Exodus 18:11). Here one voice steps out from the choir to say the same.

decisions.choice: above all gods: over every power the nations worship
decisions.reason: The psalm does not grant that the gods of the nations are real rivals: verses 15-18 call them silver and gold. The LORD is above whatever they are taken to be (95:3; 96:4-5).

decisions.choice: our Lord: the title 'Adon
decisions.reason: The word ('adon) means master or lord; it is a title, not the divine name.

decisions.choice: I am sure of it
decisions.reason: Balanced gives the emphasis of the opening "for" and "I" (the pronoun is written out in the Hebrew) with a short confession.

decisions.choice: "Chúa chúng ta" for the title 'Adon; "các thần" in lowercase for the gods
decisions.reason: "our Lord" is a title, not the divine name (see the meaning decision), so it is "Chúa" in ordinary capitals; the nations' gods are "các thần", lowercase, as in English.

decisions.choice: "हमारे प्रभु" with no setting; "देवता" for the gods
decisions.reason: "Our Lord" is the title Adon (meaning m3), so "प्रभु" stands without the divine_name setting, which marks only the name. The gods of the nations are "देवता", kept apart from "परमेश्वर", as the style guide has it.

decisions.choice: Господь наш
decisions.reason: 'Adon, "our Lord" (m3), is Господь, never in capitals, which mark the divine name.

decisions.choice: 'Adonenu "わたしたちの主" (no span); mikkol-'elohim "すべての神々にまさる" (L), "すべての神々の上に" (B), "どの神々よりも" (R)
decisions.reason: 'Adon is 主 without the divine-name span (m3; 97:5 全地の主).

source.text: כֹּ֤ל אֲשֶׁר־חָפֵ֥ץ יְהוָ֗ה עָ֫שָׂ֥ה בַּשָּׁמַ֥יִם וּבָאָ֑רֶץ בַּ֝יַּמִּ֗ים וְכָל־תְּהוֹמֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: All that delights YHWH he does, in the heavens and on the earth, in the seas and all [the] deeps.

en.L: All that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} desires {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} does, in the heavens and on the earth, in the seas and all [the] deeps.
en.B: Whatever {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} chooses to do, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} does it, in the heavens, on the earth, in the seas and in all the ocean depths.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} does anything {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} wants to do, in the sky, on the earth, in the seas, and in the deepest oceans.

fr.L: Tout ce qui plaît {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le fait, dans les cieux et sur la terre, dans les mers et tous les abîmes.
fr.B: Tout ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} veut faire, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le fait, dans les cieux, sur la terre, dans les mers et dans toutes les profondeurs.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} fait tout ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} veut, dans le ciel, sur la terre, dans les mers et au plus profond des océans.

sw.L: Yote ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anapenda hufanya, mbinguni na duniani, baharini na katika vilindi vyote.
sw.B: Lolote ambalo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anachagua kufanya, hulifanya, mbinguni, duniani, baharini na katika vilindi vyote vya bahari.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hufanya lolote analotaka kufanya, angani, duniani, baharini, na katika bahari zenye kina kirefu kabisa.

es.L: Todo lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} desea, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} lo hace, en los cielos y en la tierra, en los mares y en todos los abismos.
es.B: Todo lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} decide hacer, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} lo hace, en los cielos, en la tierra, en los mares y en todas las profundidades del océano.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hace todo lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} quiere hacer, en el cielo, en la tierra, en los mares y en los océanos más profundos.

vi.L: Mọi điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} muốn, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đều làm, trên các tầng trời và dưới đất, trong các biển và mọi vực sâu.
vi.B: Bất cứ điều gì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} muốn làm, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đều làm, trên trời, dưới đất, trong biển cả và trong mọi vực sâu.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm bất cứ điều gì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} muốn, trên bầu trời, dưới đất, trong biển cả, và trong những đại dương sâu thẳm nhất.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 원하시는 모든 것을 행하신다, 하늘에서와 땅에서, 바다들과 모든 깊은 곳에서.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 하늘에서도, 땅에서도, 바다와 모든 깊은 물속에서도 무엇이든 하고자 하시는 일을 하신다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 하늘에서나 땅에서나, 바다에서나 가장 깊은 바닷속에서나 하고 싶으신 일은 무엇이든지 하신다.

pt.L: Tudo o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} deseja {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} faz, nos céus e na terra, nos mares e em todos [os] abismos.
pt.B: Tudo o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} quer fazer, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} o faz, nos céus, na terra, nos mares e em todas as profundezas do oceano.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} faz tudo o que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} quer, no céu, na terra, nos mares e nos oceanos mais profundos.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በሰማያትና በምድር፣ በባሕሮችና በጥልቆች ሁሉ ደስ ያሰኘውን ሁሉ ያደርጋል።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በሰማያት፣ በምድር፣ በባሕሮችና በጥልቅ ውቅያኖሶች ሁሉ ሊያደርግ የወደደውን ሁሉ ያደርጋል።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በሰማይ፣ በምድር፣ በባሕሮችና በጥልቅ ውቅያኖሶች ውስጥ የሚፈልገውን ሁሉ ያደርጋል።

hi.L: जो कुछ {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} चाहते हैं, वही वे करते हैं, आकाश में और पृथ्वी पर, समुद्रों में और सब गहरे सागरों में।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} जो कुछ करना चाहते हैं, वही करते हैं, आकाश में, पृथ्वी पर, समुद्रों में और महासागरों की सारी गहराइयों में।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} जो चाहें वही करते हैं, आकाश में, धरती पर, समुद्रों में और सबसे गहरे महासागरों में।

ru.L: Всё, что угодно {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} делает, на небесах и на земле, в морях и во всех безднах.
ru.B: Всё, что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} пожелает сделать, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} делает: на небесах, на земле, в морях и во всех глубинах океана.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} делает всё, что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} хочет, — в небе, на земле, в морях и в самых глубоких океанах.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、望まれることをすべて行われる、天において、地において、海において、またすべての淵において。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、みこころのままに、何でもなさる。天でも、地でも、海でも、すべての深淵でも。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、なさりたいと思われることを、何でもなさる。空でも、地上でも、海でも、いちばん深い海の底でも。

uk.L: Усе, чого бажає {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} чинить, на небесах і на землі, в морях і в усіх безоднях.
uk.B: Усе, що {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} захоче зробити, {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} робить — на небесах, на землі, у морях і в усіх океанських глибинах.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} робить усе, що {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} хоче, — на небі, на землі, у морях і в найглибших океанах.

decisions.choice: all that he desires he does: as in 115:3
decisions.reason: Psalm 115:3 says the same of God in heaven, against the idols that can do nothing (115:4-8, repeated here in verses 15-18).

decisions.choice: the deeps: the great waters under the earth
decisions.reason: The word (tehomot) is the deep of Genesis 1:2, the waters below the earth and the sea. Heaven, earth, seas and deeps make up the whole world, and the LORD rules all of it.

decisions.choice: kol 'asher-chafets YHWH 'asah worded as 115:3 ("望まれることをすべて行われる" L, "みこころのままに、何でもなさる" B, "なさりたいと思われることを、何でもなさる" R); tehomot "淵" (L), "深淵" (B), "いちばん深い海の底" (R)
decisions.reason: The verse takes up 115:3 (m1); the deeps are the great waters under the earth (m2).

source.text: מַֽעֲלֶ֣ה נְשִׂאִים֮ מִקְצֵ֪ה הָ֫אָ֥רֶץ בְּרָקִ֣ים לַמָּטָ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה מֽוֹצֵא־ר֝וּחַ מֵאֽוֹצְרוֹתָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: Bringing up clouds from [the] end of the earth, lightnings for the rain he makes, bringing out wind from his storehouses.

en.L: [He is] bringing up clouds from the end of the earth; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} makes lightning for the rain, bringing out wind from {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} storehouses.
en.B: He raises the clouds from the far edges of the earth; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} makes lightning flash with the rain and brings the wind out of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} storehouses.
en.R: He makes clouds rise up from far away at the edge of the world. He sends lightning with the rain. He brings out the wind from the places where {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} keeps it.

fr.L: [C’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui] fait monter les nuages de l’extrémité de la terre ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fait les éclairs pour la pluie, faisant sortir le vent de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} réserves.
fr.B: Il fait monter les nuages des confins de la terre ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fait jaillir l’éclair avec la pluie et tire le vent de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} réserves.
fr.R: Il fait monter les nuages de très loin, du bout du monde. Il envoie les éclairs avec la pluie. Il fait sortir le vent des endroits où {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le garde.

sw.L: [Ndiye] anayepandisha mawingu kutoka mwisho wa dunia; hufanya umeme kwa ajili ya mvua, akitoa upepo kutoka ghala {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}.
sw.B: Huyainua mawingu kutoka miisho ya dunia; hufanya umeme umulike pamoja na mvua na kuutoa upepo katika ghala {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}.
sw.R: Huyafanya mawingu yapande kutoka mbali kwenye mwisho wa dunia. Hutuma umeme pamoja na mvua. Huutoa upepo kutoka mahali anapouhifadhi.

es.L: [Él] hace subir las nubes desde el extremo de la tierra; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} hace los relámpagos para la lluvia, sacando el viento de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} depósitos.
es.B: Él levanta las nubes desde los confines de la tierra; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} hace brillar los relámpagos con la lluvia y saca el viento de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} depósitos.
es.R: Él hace que las nubes suban desde muy lejos, en el borde del mundo. Envía los relámpagos con la lluvia. Saca el viento de los lugares donde {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} lo guarda.

vi.L: [Ngài là Đấng] khiến mây bay lên từ nơi tận cùng của đất; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm chớp nhoáng cho mưa, đem gió ra từ các kho của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Ngài khiến mây bay lên từ những nơi tận cùng của đất; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm chớp lóe lên cùng với mưa, và đem gió ra khỏi các kho của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Ngài làm cho mây bay lên từ nơi xa tít ở cuối chân trời. Ngài sai chớp đến cùng với mưa. Ngài đem gió ra từ những nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cất giữ.

ko.L: 땅끝에서 구름을 일으키시는 [분이시다]. 비를 위하여 번개를 만드시고, 그분의 창고에서 바람을 내보내신다.
ko.B: 그분께서는 땅의 먼 끝에서 구름을 일으키시고, 비와 함께 번개를 번쩍이게 하시며, 그분의 창고에서 바람을 꺼내신다.
ko.R: 그분께서는 저 멀리 세상 끝에서 구름이 피어오르게 하신다. 비와 함께 번개를 보내신다. 바람을 두신 곳에서 바람을 꺼내 보내신다.

pt.L: [Ele está] fazendo subir nuvens desde a extremidade da terra; {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} faz relâmpagos para a chuva, tirando o vento dos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} depósitos.
pt.B: Ele faz subir as nuvens dos confins da terra; {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} faz o relâmpago brilhar com a chuva e tira o vento dos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} depósitos.
pt.R: Ele faz as nuvens subirem lá longe, na beira do mundo. Ele manda relâmpagos com a chuva. Ele tira o vento dos lugares onde {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} o guarda.

am.L: ከምድር ዳርቻ ደመናትን ያወጣል፤ ለዝናብ መብረቅን ያደርጋል፤ ከመዛግብቱ ነፋስን ያወጣል።
am.B: ከሩቅ የምድር ዳርቻ ደመናትን ያስነሣል፤ ከዝናብ ጋር መብረቅን ያበርቃል፤ ከመዛግብቱም ነፋስን ያወጣል።
am.R: ከዓለም ዳርቻ ከሩቅ ስፍራ ደመናትን ያስነሣል። ከዝናብ ጋር መብረቅን ይልካል። ነፋስን ከሚያስቀምጥበት ስፍራ ያወጣዋል።

hi.L: [वे] पृथ्वी के छोर से बादल उठाते हैं; वे वर्षा के लिए बिजलियाँ बनाते हैं, अपने भंडारों से हवा निकालते हैं।
hi.B: वे पृथ्वी के दूर-दूर के छोरों से बादल उठाते हैं; वर्षा के साथ बिजली चमकाते हैं और अपने भंडारों से हवा निकाल लाते हैं।
hi.R: वे दुनिया के दूर के किनारे से बादल उठाते हैं। वे वर्षा के साथ बिजली भेजते हैं। वे हवा को उन जगहों से निकाल लाते हैं जहाँ वे उसे रखते हैं।

ru.L: [Он] поднимает облака от края земли; {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} творит молнии для дождя, выводит ветер из хранилищ своих.
ru.B: Он поднимает облака от дальних краёв земли; {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} заставляет молнии сверкать с дождём и выводит ветер из своих хранилищ.
ru.R: Он поднимает облака издалека, с края земли. Он посылает молнии с дождём. Он выводит ветер из мест, где {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} хранит его.

ja.L: [その方は]地の果てから雲を上らせ、雨のために稲妻を造り、ご自分の倉から風を取り出してこられる。
ja.B: その方は地の果てから雲を立ち上らせ、雨と共に稲妻をひらめかせ、ご自分の倉から風を吹き出させる。
ja.R: その方は、遠い地の果てから雲をわき上がらせる。雨と一緒に稲妻を送り、しまっておいた所から風を吹き出させる。

uk.L: [Він] підіймає хмари від краю землі; {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} робить блискавки для дощу, виводячи вітер зі своїх сховищ.
uk.B: Він підіймає хмари з далеких країв землі; {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} дає блискавкам спалахувати з дощем і виводить вітер зі своїх сховищ.
uk.R: Він підіймає хмари далеко на краю світу. Він посилає блискавки з дощем. Він виводить вітер з тих місць, де {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} його тримає.

decisions.choice: the same words as Jeremiah 10:13 and 51:16
decisions.reason: This verse appears almost word for word in Jeremiah 10:13 and 51:16, in passages that also mock idols (Jeremiah 10:3-5, 14), as this psalm does in verses 15-18.

decisions.choice: his storehouses: the wind kept ready by God
decisions.reason: Wind, rain, snow and hail are pictured as kept in God's storerooms until he sends them out (Job 38:22; 33:7).

decisions.choice: lightnings for the rain: lightning with the rain
decisions.reason: The lightning goes with the storm that brings rain. The rain god of Canaan was praised for storms; here the LORD makes them.

decisions.choice: [He is]
decisions.reason: The Hebrew begins with a participle, "bringing up"; Literal supplies the subject in brackets.

decisions.choice: beraqim lammatar "雨のために稲妻を" (L), "雨と共に稲妻を" (B, R); otsrotaw "ご自分の倉" (L, B), "しまっておいた所" (R)
decisions.reason: Lightning with the rain (m3); the storehouses keep the wind ready (m2). Causatives stay plain (Psalter rule).

source.text: שֶֽׁ֭הִכָּה בְּכוֹרֵ֣י מִצְרָ֑יִם מֵ֝אָדָ֗ם עַד־בְּהֵמָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: who struck down [the] firstborn of Egypt, from human to animal.

en.L: [It is {{deity_pronoun:he|He}}] who struck down the firstborn of Egypt, from human to animal.
en.B: He struck down the firstborn of Egypt, of people and of animals alike.
en.R: He killed every firstborn in Egypt, the oldest sons of the people and the firstborn of the animals.

fr.L: [C’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}] qui a frappé les premiers-nés d’Égypte, de l’humain jusqu’à la bête.
fr.B: Il a frappé les premiers-nés d’Égypte, ceux des humains comme ceux des bêtes.
fr.R: Il a fait mourir tous les premiers-nés en Égypte, les fils aînés des gens et les premiers-nés des animaux.

sw.L: [Ni {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}] aliyewapiga wazaliwa wa kwanza wa Misri, tangu mwanadamu hadi mnyama.
sw.B: Aliwapiga wazaliwa wa kwanza wa Misri, wa watu na wa wanyama pia.
sw.R: Aliua kila mzaliwa wa kwanza huko Misri, wana wa kwanza wa watu na wazaliwa wa kwanza wa wanyama.

es.L: [Es {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}] quien hirió a los primogénitos de Egipto, desde el ser humano hasta el animal.
es.B: Él hirió a los primogénitos de Egipto, tanto de las personas como de los animales.
es.R: Él mató a todos los primogénitos de Egipto, a los hijos mayores de la gente y a las primeras crías de los animales.

vi.L: [Chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đấng] đã đánh giết các con đầu lòng của Ai Cập, từ người cho đến thú vật.
vi.B: Ngài đã đánh giết các con đầu lòng của Ai Cập, cả người lẫn thú vật.
vi.R: Ngài đã giết mọi con đầu lòng ở Ai Cập, con trai cả của người ta và con đầu lòng của thú vật.

ko.L: [그분께서] 이집트의 맏이들을 치셨으니, 사람부터 짐승까지이다.
ko.B: 그분께서 이집트의 맏이들을 치셨으니, 사람이나 짐승이나 다 그러했다.
ko.R: 그분께서는 이집트에서 처음 태어난 것을 모두 죽이셨다. 사람의 맏아들도, 짐승의 첫 새끼도 죽이셨다.

pt.L: [É {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}] quem feriu os primogênitos do Egito, desde o ser humano até o animal.
pt.B: Ele feriu os primogênitos do Egito, tanto de pessoas como de animais.
pt.R: Ele matou todos os primogênitos do Egito: os filhos mais velhos das pessoas e as primeiras crias dos animais.

am.L: የግብፅን በኩር ከሰው እስከ እንስሳ የመታ [እርሱ ነው]።
am.B: የግብፅን በኩር ሁሉ፣ የሰውንም የእንስሳንም መታ።
am.R: በግብፅ የነበረውን በኩር ሁሉ ገደለ፤ የሰዎችን የበኩር ወንድ ልጆችና የእንስሳትን በኩር ገደለ።

hi.L: [वे ही हैं] जिन्होंने मिस्र के पहलौठों को मारा, मनुष्य से लेकर पशु तक।
hi.B: उन्होंने मिस्र के पहलौठों को मार डाला, मनुष्यों के भी और पशुओं के भी।
hi.R: उन्होंने मिस्र के हर पहलौठे को मार डाला, लोगों के सबसे बड़े बेटों को और पशुओं के पहलौठों को।

ru.L: [Это {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}},] который поразил первенцев Египта, от человека до скота.
ru.B: Он поразил первенцев Египта, и людей и животных.
ru.R: Он убил всех первенцев в Египте — старших сыновей у людей и первенцев у животных.

ja.L: [その方は]エジプトの初子を、人から家畜に至るまで、お打ちになった。
ja.B: その方は、人も家畜も、エジプトの初子をお打ちになった。
ja.R: その方は、エジプトの長男をみな、そして家畜の初子もみな、死なせた。

uk.L: [Це {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}}] уразив первістків Єгипту, від людини до тварини.
uk.B: Він уразив первістків Єгипту — і людей, і тварин.
uk.R: Він убив кожного первістка в Єгипті — старших синів людей і первістків тварин.

decisions.choice: the death of Egypt's firstborn
decisions.reason: The last of the plagues on Egypt, from Pharaoh's son to the firstborn of the livestock (Exodus 12:29). The psalm now tells the story of the exodus and the conquest (verses 8-12), as Psalm 136 does at greater length.

decisions.choice: the oldest sons
decisions.reason: Readable explains "firstborn" for people: the firstborn son of each family (Exodus 12:29).

decisions.choice: "l'humain", "des humains", "des gens" for ʾadam set against animals, with no gender setting
decisions.reason: Here ʾadam stands against "animal", meaning people as opposed to beasts; the English has no setting either. French says "humain" plainly, which is the inclusive default the gender setting would give.

decisions.choice: "이집트" for Egypt
decisions.reason: "이집트" is the name of the country in modern Korean; "애굽" is the older church form, which the style guide's preference for the modern word sets aside; a native reviewer may prefer the traditional Protestant form.

decisions.choice: hikkah "お打ちになった" (L, B), "死なせた" (R); bekhorei "初子" (L, B), "長男 / 初子" (R)
decisions.reason: As 78:51 and 105:36 (bekhor 初子 L, B, 長男 R); お打ちになる avoids 打たれた, which reads passive.

source.text: שָׁלַ֤ח׀אֹת֣וֹת וּ֭מֹפְתִים בְּתוֹכֵ֣כִי מִצְרָ֑יִם בְּ֝פַרְעֹ֗ה וּבְכָל־עֲבָדָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: He sent signs and wonders into your midst, Egypt, on Pharaoh and on all his servants.

en.L: He sent signs and wonders into your midst, Egypt, against Pharaoh and against all his servants.
en.B: Into your very heart, Egypt, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} sent signs and wonders, against Pharaoh and all his officials.
en.R: Egypt, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} did amazing things among you that showed {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} power. He did them against Pharaoh and all his officials.

fr.L: Il a envoyé des signes et des prodiges au milieu de toi, Égypte, contre Pharaon et contre tous ses esclaves.
fr.B: Au cœur même de ton pays, Égypte, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a envoyé des signes et des prodiges, contre Pharaon et tous ses ministres.
fr.R: Égypte, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fait chez toi des choses étonnantes qui montraient {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} puissance. Il les a faites contre Pharaon et tous ses ministres.

sw.L: Alituma ishara na maajabu katikati yako, Ee Misri, juu ya Farao na juu ya watumishi wake wote.
sw.B: Katikati yako kabisa, Ee Misri, alituma ishara na maajabu, dhidi ya Farao na maafisa wake wote.
sw.R: Misri, alifanya mambo ya ajabu kati yako yaliyoonyesha uweza {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. Aliyafanya dhidi ya Farao na maafisa wake wote.

es.L: Envió señales y prodigios en medio de ti, Egipto, contra el faraón y contra todos sus siervos.
es.B: En tu mismo corazón, Egipto, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} envió señales y prodigios, contra el faraón y todos sus funcionarios.
es.R: Egipto, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} hizo en medio de ti cosas asombrosas que mostraban {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} poder. Las hizo contra el faraón y todos sus funcionarios.

vi.L: Ngài đã sai các dấu lạ và phép lạ vào giữa ngươi, hỡi Ai Cập, nghịch cùng Pha-ra-ôn và nghịch cùng mọi đầy tớ của vua.
vi.B: Hỡi Ai Cập, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã sai các dấu lạ và phép lạ vào ngay giữa lòng ngươi, nghịch cùng Pha-ra-ôn và mọi quan chức của vua.
vi.R: Hỡi Ai Cập, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm những việc kỳ diệu giữa ngươi, cho thấy quyền năng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Ngài làm những việc ấy để chống lại Pha-ra-ôn và mọi quan chức của vua.

ko.L: 이집트야, 그분께서 네 한가운데로 표적과 기이한 일들을 보내셨으니, 바로와 그의 모든 신하에게 [보내셨다].
ko.B: 이집트야, 그분께서 바로 네 한복판에 표적과 기이한 일들을 보내셔서, 바로와 그의 모든 신하를 치셨다.
ko.R: 이집트야, 그분께서 너희 가운데서 그분의 능력을 보여 주는 놀라운 일들을 하셨다. 바로와 그의 모든 신하에게 그 일을 하셨다.

pt.L: Ele enviou sinais e prodígios no teu meio, Egito, contra Faraó e contra todos os seus servos.
pt.B: Bem no teu meio, Egito, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} enviou sinais e maravilhas, contra Faraó e todos os seus oficiais.
pt.R: Egito, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez no meio de ti coisas espantosas, que mostravam o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} poder. Ele as fez contra Faraó e todos os oficiais dele.

am.L: ግብፅ ሆይ፣ በፈርዖንና በባሪያዎቹ ሁሉ ላይ ምልክቶችንና ድንቆችን ወደ መካከልሽ ላከ።
am.B: ግብፅ ሆይ፣ በፈርዖንና በሹማምንቱ ሁሉ ላይ በልብሽ ውስጥ ምልክቶችንና ድንቆችን ላከ።
am.R: ግብፅ ሆይ፣ በመካከልሽ ኃይሉን የሚያሳዩ ድንቅ ነገሮችን አደረገ። እነዚህን ያደረገው በፈርዖንና በሹማምንቱ ሁሉ ላይ ነው።

hi.L: उन्होंने, हे मिस्र, तुम्हारे बीच चिह्न और अद्भुत काम भेजे, फ़िरौन पर और उसके सब कर्मचारियों पर।
hi.B: हे मिस्र, उन्होंने तुम्हारे ठीक बीच में चिह्न और अद्भुत काम भेजे, फ़िरौन और उसके सब अधिकारियों के विरुद्ध।
hi.R: हे मिस्र, उन्होंने तुम्हारे बीच ऐसे अद्भुत काम किए जिनसे उनकी शक्ति दिखाई दी। उन्होंने ये काम फ़िरौन और उसके सब अधिकारियों के विरुद्ध किए।

ru.L: Он послал знамения и чудеса посреди тебя, Египет, на фараона и на всех рабов его.
ru.B: В самое сердце твоё, Египет, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} послал знамения и чудеса — против фараона и всех его приближённых.
ru.R: Египет, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} совершил среди тебя удивительные дела, которые показали {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} силу. Он совершил их против фараона и всех его приближённых.

decisions.choice: Sihon and Og: two kings east of the Jordan
decisions.reason: Sihon ruled the Amorites from Heshbon, and Og ruled Bashan, the high, fertile land east of the Sea of Galilee. Israel defeated both before crossing the Jordan (Numbers 21:21-35; Deuteronomy 2-3). Their defeat was remembered as the first sign that the land would be given (Joshua 2:10).

decisions.choice: to Sihon: the kings are what he killed
decisions.reason: The small word "to" before each name marks them as the ones killed (verse 10), a use found in later Hebrew.

decisions.choice: He killed ... He defeated
decisions.reason: Readable repeats the verbs of verse 10 so that each sentence stands on its own (m2).

decisions.choice: "Si-hôn", "Óc", "A-mô-rít", "Ba-san", "Ca-na-an"
decisions.reason: The names take the Protestant tradition's forms, which Vietnamese Bible readers know.

decisions.choice: The kings are named in a sentence of their own ("...이다")
alternatives: 시혼과 옥을 죽이셨으니 carried into verse 10
decisions.reason: Korean puts the object before its verb, so the names cannot follow "killed" in verse 10 as in the Hebrew; a short identifying sentence keeps them in verse 11.

decisions.choice: Seom, rei dos amorreus; Ogue, rei de Basã; Canaã
decisions.reason: The names as Numbers, Deuteronomy and Joshua have them in Portuguese, and as Psalm 136:19-20 repeats them.

decisions.reason: The forms of Deuteronomy 1:4 and 1 Kings 4:19 on main; Psalm 136:19-20 uses the same.
