am.R: ምድራቸውንም የራሳቸው አድርገው እንዲይዙ ለሕዝቡ ለእስራኤል ሰጣቸው።

hi.L: और उन्होंने उनका देश निज भाग [करके] दे दिया, अपनी प्रजा इस्राएल को निज भाग।
hi.B: और उनका देश निज भाग के रूप में दे दिया, अपनी प्रजा इस्राएल का निज भाग।
hi.R: उन्होंने उनका देश अपनी प्रजा इस्राएल को दे दिया, कि वह सदा उनका अपना रहे।

ru.L: и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} отдал землю их [в] наследие, в наследие Израилю, народу своему.
ru.B: и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} отдал их землю в наследие, в наследие своему народу Израилю.
ru.R: Он отдал их землю своему народу Израилю во владение навсегда.

ja.L: そして、彼らの地を嗣業として、ご自分の民イスラエルへの嗣業として、お与えになった。
ja.B: そして、彼らの土地を嗣業として、ご自分の民イスラエルが受け継ぐものとして、お与えになった。
ja.R: そして、その土地を、ご自分の民イスラエルに、ずっと自分たちのものとするように与えてくださった。

uk.L: і {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} дав їхню землю [як] спадщину, спадщину Ізраїлеві, своєму народові.
uk.B: і {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} віддав їхню землю у спадщину, у спадщину для свого народу Ізраїля.
uk.R: Він віддав їхню землю своєму народові Ізраїлеві, щоб вона була їхньою назавжди.

decisions.choice: inheritance: land held by a family for good
decisions.reason: An inheritance (nachalah) is land that belongs to a family and passes from parents to children. The land of Canaan was shared out to Israel's tribes in this way (Joshua 13-21).

decisions.choice: to keep as their own
decisions.reason: Readable says what an inheritance is (m1) and does not repeat the word.

decisions.choice: "निज भाग"
decisions.reason: The inheritance, land held by a family for good (meaning m1), is "निज भाग", as in Deuteronomy in this translation; Readable says what it means, as the English does.

decisions.choice: nachalah "嗣業" (L, B), "ずっと自分たちのものとするように" (R)
decisions.reason: Psalter rule (nachalah 嗣業 L, B; R by sense): land held by a family for good (m1).

source.text: יְ֭הוָה שִׁמְךָ֣ לְעוֹלָ֑ם יְ֝הוָ֗ה זִכְרְךָ֥ לְדֹר־וָדֹֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH, your name [is] forever; YHWH, your remembrance [is] to generation and generation.

en.L: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name [is] forever; {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} remembrance [is] to generation and generation.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name will last forever; {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, people will remember {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} in every generation.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name will last forever. People in every generation will remember {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}.

fr.L: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom [est] pour toujours ; {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} souvenir [est] de génération en génération.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom durera toujours ; {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, on se souviendra de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} de génération en génération.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom durera toujours. Les gens de chaque génération se souviendront de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} [ni] la milele; Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ukumbusho {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} [ni] kwa kizazi na kizazi.
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} litadumu milele; Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, watu watakukumbuka katika kila kizazi.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} litadumu milele. Watu wa kila kizazi watakukumbuka, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

es.L: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre [es] para siempre; {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} memoria [es] de generación en generación.
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre durará para siempre; {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, la gente {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} recordará en cada generación.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre durará para siempre. La gente de cada generación se acordará de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

vi.L: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [còn] đến đời đời; lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, sự ghi nhớ về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [còn] từ đời nọ sang đời kia.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ còn đến đời đời; lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, người ta sẽ ghi nhớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} qua mọi thế hệ.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ còn mãi mãi. Người ta ở mọi thế hệ sẽ nhớ đến {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님의 이름은 영원합니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님을 기억함이 대대에 [이릅니다].
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님의 이름은 영원히 이어질 것입니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 대대로 사람들이 주님을 기억할 것입니다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님의 이름은 영원히 남을 것입니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 모든 세대의 사람들이 주님을 기억할 것입니다.

pt.L: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome [é] para sempre; {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} lembrança [é] de geração em geração.
pt.B: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome durará para sempre; {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, as pessoas {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} lembrarão em todas as gerações.
pt.R: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome vai durar para sempre. As pessoas de todas as gerações vão se lembrar de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ስምህ ለዘላለም [ነው]፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ መታሰቢያህ ከትውልድ እስከ ትውልድ [ነው]።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ስምህ ለዘላለም ይኖራል፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ሰዎች በየትውልዱ ያስቡሃል።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ስምህ ለዘላለም ይኖራል። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ በየትውልዱ ያሉ ሰዎች ያስቡሃል።

hi.L: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, तेरा नाम सदा का [है]; हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, तेरा स्मरण पीढ़ी से पीढ़ी तक [है]।
hi.B: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, तेरा नाम सदा बना रहेगा; हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, हर पीढ़ी में तुझे याद किया जाएगा।
hi.R: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, तेरा नाम सदा बना रहेगा। हर पीढ़ी के लोग तुझे याद करेंगे, हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}।

ru.L: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, имя {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} — вовек; {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, память {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} — из рода в род.
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} имя пребудет вечно; {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, люди будут помнить {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} в каждом поколении.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} имя будет жить вечно. Люди в каждом поколении будут помнить {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、あなたの名はとこしえに[続く]。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、あなたの記念は代々に[続く]。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、あなたの名は、とこしえに続く。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、人々は代々にわたって、あなたを覚え続ける。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、あなたの名は、いつまでも残る。どの時代の人々も、あなたを覚えている、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ。

uk.L: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} імʼя — навіки; {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, памʼять про {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} — з роду в рід.
uk.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} імʼя триватиме навіки; {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, люди памʼятатимуть {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} в кожному поколінні.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} імʼя триватиме вічно. Люди в кожному поколінні памʼятатимуть {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}.

decisions.choice: your name, your remembrance: Exodus 3:15
decisions.reason: At the burning bush God said, "This is my name forever, and this is my remembrance from generation to generation" (Exodus 3:15). The psalm turns those words into praise; 102:13 does the same.

decisions.choice: remembrance: the name by which he is remembered
decisions.reason: The word (zekher) is what keeps someone in memory, especially the name that is called on in worship.

decisions.choice: people will remember you
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable turn the noun into a verb (m2).

decisions.choice: Verse 13 alone speaks to God, in 합쇼체; verse 14 returns to the plain style
alternatives: the plain style for the whole psalm
decisions.reason: The hymn turns for one verse to address the LORD ("your name"); Korean marks the turn with the polite style of prayer (style guide section 7a).

decisions.choice: o teu nome [é] para sempre; a tua lembrança [é] de geração em geração
decisions.reason: The words God spoke at the burning bush (Exodus 3:15, m1), in that verse's Portuguese at Literal, now said back to God.

decisions.choice: "your name … your remembrance to generation and generation" as "ስምህ … መታሰቢያህ ከትውልድ እስከ ትውልድ" (Literal), "በየትውልዱ ያስቡሃል" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording of Exodus 3:15 on main ("ስሜ … ከትውልድ እስከ ትውልድም መታሰቢያዬ"; Balanced and Readable "በየትውልዱ"), which the verse echoes (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: "तेरा स्मरण पीढ़ी से पीढ़ी तक" (L); "याद किया जाएगा", "याद करेंगे" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The line echoes Exodus 3:15 (meaning m1), whose Hindi in this translation it follows at each level, turned from God's "मेरा" to the psalmist's "तेरा".

decisions.choice: zikhrekha "あなたの記念" (L), "人々は…あなたを覚え続ける" (B), "どの時代の人々も、あなたを覚えている" (R); ledor-vador "代々に"
decisions.reason: The name by which he is remembered (m2), as Exodus 3:15 (m1).

source.text: כִּֽי־יָדִ֣ין יְהוָ֣ה עַמּ֑וֹ וְעַל־עֲ֝בָדָ֗יו יִתְנֶחָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: For YHWH will vindicate his people, and on his servants he will have compassion.

en.L: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will judge {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people, and on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servants {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will have compassion.
en.B: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will take up the cause of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people and show pity to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servants.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will defend {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people. He will be kind and caring to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servants.

fr.L: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} jugera {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple, et de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} esclaves {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} aura compassion.
fr.B: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} prendra la défense de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} aura pitié de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} serviteurs.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} défendra {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple. Il sera bon et plein de tendresse pour {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} serviteurs.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawahukumu watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, na juu ya watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} atakuwa na huruma.
sw.B: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawatetea watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} na kuwaonea huruma watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawatetea watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. Atakuwa mwema na kuwajali watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.

es.L: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} juzgará a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo, y de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} siervos {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} tendrá compasión.
es.B: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} defenderá la causa de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo y tendrá compasión de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} siervos.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} defenderá a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo. Será bondadoso y cuidará de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} siervos.

vi.L: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ xét xử cho dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ thương xót các đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ bênh vực dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và thương xót các đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ bảo vệ dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Ngài sẽ tử tế và chăm sóc các đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 참으로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 백성을 판결하시고, 그분의 종들에게 긍휼을 베푸실 것이다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 백성의 편에 서서 변호하시고, 그분의 종들을 불쌍히 여기실 것이다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 백성을 지켜 주실 것이다. 그분의 종들에게 친절하고 따뜻하게 대해 주실 것이다.

pt.L: Pois {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} julgará o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo, e dos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} servos {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} terá compaixão.
pt.B: Pois {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} fará justiça ao {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo e terá piedade dos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} servos.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} vai defender o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo. Ele vai ser bondoso e cuidadoso com os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} servos.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ለሕዝቡ ይፈርዳልና፤ ለባሪያዎቹም ይራራል።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ለሕዝቡ ይቆማልና፤ ለአገልጋዮቹም ይራራል።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሕዝቡን ይከላከላል። ለአገልጋዮቹ ይራራል፤ ይንከባከባቸዋልም።

hi.L: क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपनी प्रजा का न्याय करेंगे, और अपने दासों पर दया करेंगे।
hi.B: क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपनी प्रजा का न्याय चुकाएँगे और अपने दासों पर तरस खाएँगे।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपनी प्रजा का पक्ष लेंगे। वे अपने दासों पर दया करेंगे।

ru.L: Ведь {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} будет судить народ свой, и над рабами своими {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} сжалится.
ru.B: Ведь {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} заступится за свой народ и проявит жалость к своим рабам.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} будет защищать свой народ. Он будет добр к своим рабам и позаботится о них.

ja.L: まことに、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はご自分の民を裁き、ご自分のしもべたちをあわれんでくださる。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、ご自分の民の訴えを取り上げ、ご自分のしもべたちをあわれんでくださるからだ。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、ご自分の民を守ってくださる。ご自分のしもべたちに、やさしく思いやりを示してくださる。

uk.L: Бо {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} судитиме свій народ, і над своїми рабами {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} змилується.
uk.B: Бо {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} стане на захист свого народу й виявить жаль своїм рабам.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} захистить свій народ. Він буде добрим і дбайливим до своїх слуг.

decisions.choice: the words of Deuteronomy 32:36
decisions.reason: The verse repeats Deuteronomy 32:36, from the song of Moses. Hebrews 10:30 quotes the same line, "The Lord will judge his people", as a warning to believers.

decisions.choice: judge: do justice for, take their side
decisions.reason: The verb (din) is to judge or to plead a cause. Here, after the rescue from Egypt and the gift of the land, it means that the LORD will see justice done for his people, as in Deuteronomy 32:36.

decisions.choice: have compassion: change his mind and show pity
decisions.reason: The verb (nicham, reflexive) means to be moved to pity, or to change one's course out of pity.

decisions.choice: take up the cause of (B); defend (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of the verb here (m2); Literal keeps "judge".

decisions.choice: julgará (L); fará justiça (B); vai defender (R); terá compaixão / piedade
decisions.reason: The line is Deuteronomy 32:36 (m1), so each level keeps that verse's Portuguese; Literal's "julgará o seu povo" is also the wording of Hebrews 10:30 in Portuguese.

decisions.choice: the first two lines of Deuteronomy 32:36 on main ("እግዚአብሔር (alternative ያህዌ) ለሕዝቡ ይፈርዳልና፤ ለባሪያዎቹም ይራራል"; Readable "ሕዝቡን ይከላከላል"), Balanced "ለሕዝቡ ይቆማል" (takes up their cause)
decisions.reason: The psalm quotes Moses' song word for word (meaning decision m1); the Amharic keeps it, with Balanced following its own English in "take up the cause".

decisions.choice: the Hindi of Deuteronomy 32:36
decisions.reason: The verse repeats the first lines of Deuteronomy 32:36 (meaning m1), and keeps their Hindi at each level, without the poem's line breaks, since the English here has none.

decisions.choice: свой, своим, with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: The English has spans on "his" people and servants; Russian uses the reflexive свой, which takes no deity_pronoun span in this translation.

decisions.choice: yadin "裁き" (L), "訴えを取り上げ" (B), "守ってくださる" (R); yitnecham "あわれんでくださる" (L, B), "やさしく思いやりを示してくださる" (R)
decisions.reason: Judging here is taking their side (m2) and showing pity (m3), the words of Deuteronomy 32:36 (m1); あわれんでくださる, not あわれまれる, as 103:13.

source.text: עֲצַבֵּ֣י הַ֭גּוֹיִם כֶּ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֑ב מַ֝עֲשֵׂ֗ה יְדֵ֣י אָדָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] idols of the nations [are] silver and gold, [the] work of [the] hands of humankind.

en.L: The idols of the nations [are] silver and gold, the work of human hands.
en.B: The idols of the nations are made of silver and gold, shaped by human hands.
en.R: The idols of the nations are only silver and gold. People made them with their own hands.

fr.L: Les idoles des nations [sont] argent et or, l’œuvre des mains humaines.
fr.B: Les idoles des nations sont faites d’argent et d’or, façonnées par des mains humaines.
fr.R: Les idoles des nations ne sont que de l’argent et de l’or. Ce sont des gens qui les ont faites de leurs mains.

sw.L: Miungu ya sanamu ya mataifa [ni] fedha na dhahabu, kazi ya mikono ya binadamu.
sw.B: Sanamu za mataifa zimeundwa kwa fedha na dhahabu, zimefanyizwa kwa mikono ya binadamu.
sw.R: Sanamu za mataifa ni fedha na dhahabu tu. Watu walizitengeneza kwa mikono yao wenyewe.

es.L: Los ídolos de las naciones [son] plata y oro, obra de manos humanas.
es.B: Los ídolos de las naciones están hechos de plata y oro, formados por manos humanas.
es.R: Los ídolos de las naciones no son más que plata y oro. La gente los hizo con sus propias manos.

vi.L: Các thần tượng của các dân tộc [là] bạc và vàng, công việc của tay loài người.
vi.B: Các thần tượng của các dân tộc được làm bằng bạc và vàng, do tay loài người tạo nên.
vi.R: Các thần tượng của các dân tộc chỉ là bạc và vàng. Người ta làm ra chúng bằng chính tay mình.

ko.L: 민족들의 우상들은 은과 금이고, 사람 손이 만든 것이다.
ko.B: 민족들의 우상은 은과 금으로 만든 것이며, 사람의 손으로 빚은 것이다.
ko.R: 민족들의 우상은 은과 금일 뿐이다. 사람들이 자기 손으로 그것들을 만들었다.

pt.L: Os ídolos das nações [são] prata e ouro, obra de mãos humanas.
pt.B: Os ídolos das nações são feitos de prata e ouro, moldados por mãos humanas.
pt.R: Os ídolos das nações são só prata e ouro. Foram pessoas que os fizeram com as próprias mãos.

am.L: የሕዝቦች ጣዖታት ብርና ወርቅ [ናቸው]፤ የሰው እጅ ሥራ።
am.B: የሕዝቦች ጣዖታት ከብርና ከወርቅ የተሠሩ ናቸው፤ በሰው እጅ የተቀረጹ ናቸው።
am.R: የሕዝቦች ጣዖታት ብርና ወርቅ ብቻ ናቸው። ሰዎች በገዛ እጃቸው ሠሯቸው።

hi.L: जातियों की मूर्तियाँ चाँदी और सोना [हैं], मनुष्यों के हाथों का काम।
hi.B: दूसरे देशों की मूर्तियाँ चाँदी और सोने से बनी हैं, मनुष्यों के हाथों से गढ़ी गई।
hi.R: दूसरे देशों की मूर्तियाँ बस चाँदी और सोना हैं। लोगों ने उन्हें अपने ही हाथों से बनाया है।

ru.L: Идолы народов — серебро и золото, дело рук человеческих.
ru.B: Идолы народов сделаны из серебра и золота, созданы руками людей.
ru.R: Идолы народов — всего лишь серебро и золото. Люди сделали их своими руками.

ja.L: 諸国の民の偶像は銀と金、人の手のわざ。
ja.B: 諸国の民の偶像は銀と金で作られ、人の手で形づくられたもの。
ja.R: 国々の偶像は、ただの銀と金にすぎない。人間が自分の手で作ったものだ。

uk.L: Ідоли народів — срібло й золото, робота людських рук.
uk.B: Ідоли народів зроблені зі срібла й золота, виліплені людськими руками.
uk.R: Ідоли народів — це лише срібло й золото. Люди зробили їх власними руками.

decisions.choice: verses 15-18 repeat 115:4-8
decisions.reason: These verses repeat the mockery of idols in 115:4-8, with small changes: this psalm says "the idols of the nations", leaves out the lines on noses, hands, feet and throats, and adds that there is no breath in their mouths (verse 17).

decisions.choice: idols: images shaped by craftsmen
decisions.reason: The word ('atsabbim) is used for images of gods, things carved or cast. Silver and gold are what they are made of, and all they are.

decisions.choice: only silver and gold
decisions.reason: Readable brings out the scorn in the plain statement: they are nothing more than metal.

decisions.choice: the Portuguese of 115:4-8
decisions.reason: Verses 15-18 repeat 115:4-8 (m1), so each level repeats that passage's Portuguese word for word where the Hebrew is the same: "das nações" is added in verse 15, and verse 17 has "dar ouvidos" (L) and "nem fôlego na sua boca" where the Hebrew differs from 115:6.

decisions.choice: Verses 15-18 copy the Amharic of Psalm 115:4-8 level by level where the Hebrew is the same (verses 16 and 18 entirely); here "the idols of the nations" ("የሕዝቦች ጣዖታት") for 115:4's "their idols"; in verse 17 "give ear" ("አያደምጡም", Literal) and "no breath in their mouth" replace 115:6's noses
decisions.reason: The passage repeats Psalm 115:4-8 (meaning decision m1); repeated passages read alike where the Hebrew is the same, and differ only where this psalm's Hebrew does (it also lacks 115:7's hands and feet).

decisions.choice: the Hindi of Psalm 115:4-8; "जातियों की" (L), "दूसरे देशों की" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Verses 15-18 repeat Psalm 115:4-8 (meaning m1). Where the Hebrew is the same, each level copies the Hindi of 115:4-8 (verses 16 and 18 entirely, and verse 15 apart from its opening). Here the Hebrew says "the idols of the nations" where 115:4 has "their idols", so Literal says "जातियों की" and Balanced "दूसरे देशों की", as Readable already does in 115:4; the nations are "जातियाँ" at Literal only, as the poetry note has it.

decisions.choice: the wording of Psalm 115:4-8
decisions.reason: Verses 15-18 repeat Psalm 115:4-8 (m1). Each level copies the Russian of Psalm 115 where the Hebrew is the same; here only "the idols of the nations" differs from 115:4's "their idols", and in verse 17 the second half ("no breath in their mouth") differs from 115:6b.

decisions.choice: 135:15-18 copied from 115:4-8 at each level; changed only where the Hebrew differs: 'atsabbei haggoyim "諸国の民の偶像" (L, B) for 115:4's "彼らの偶像" (R already 国々の偶像)
decisions.reason: The verses repeat 115:4-8 (m1, PSA-12 note); the Japanese repeats them word for word where the Hebrew is the same.

source.text: פֶּֽה־לָ֭הֶם וְלֹ֣א יְדַבֵּ֑רוּ עֵינַ֥יִם לָ֝הֶ֗ם וְלֹ֣א יִרְאֽוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: A mouth [is] to them, and not they speak; eyes [are] to them, and not they see.

en.L: They have a mouth, but they do not speak; they have eyes, but they do not see.
en.B: They have a mouth, yet say nothing; they have eyes, yet see nothing.
en.R: Idols have mouths, but they cannot talk. They have eyes, but they cannot see.

fr.L: Elles ont une bouche, mais elles ne parlent pas ; elles ont des yeux, mais elles ne voient pas.
fr.B: Elles ont une bouche, et pourtant elles ne disent rien ; elles ont des yeux, et pourtant elles ne voient rien.
fr.R: Les idoles ont une bouche, mais elles ne peuvent pas parler. Elles ont des yeux, mais elles ne peuvent pas voir.

sw.L: Kinywa zinacho, lakini hazisemi; macho zinayo, lakini hazioni.
sw.B: Zina kinywa, lakini hazitamki neno; zina macho, lakini hazioni kitu.
sw.R: Sanamu zina vinywa, lakini haziwezi kuongea. Zina macho, lakini haziwezi kuona.

es.L: Tienen boca, pero no hablan; tienen ojos, pero no ven.
es.B: Tienen boca, y no dicen nada; tienen ojos, y no ven nada.
es.R: Los ídolos tienen boca, pero no pueden hablar. Tienen ojos, pero no pueden ver.

vi.L: Chúng có miệng, nhưng không nói; chúng có mắt, nhưng không thấy.
vi.B: Chúng có miệng mà chẳng nói được gì; có mắt mà chẳng thấy gì.
vi.R: Thần tượng có miệng nhưng không thể nói. Chúng có mắt nhưng không thể thấy.

ko.L: 그것들에게 입이 있어도 말하지 못하고, 눈이 있어도 보지 못한다.
ko.B: 입이 있어도 아무 말도 못 하고, 눈이 있어도 아무것도 보지 못한다.
ko.R: 우상들은 입이 있지만 말을 할 수 없다. 눈이 있지만 볼 수 없다.

pt.L: Têm boca, mas não falam; têm olhos, mas não veem.
pt.B: Têm boca, mas nada dizem; têm olhos, mas nada veem.
pt.R: Os ídolos têm boca, mas não conseguem falar. Têm olhos, mas não conseguem ver.

am.L: አፍ አላቸው፤ ግን አይናገሩም፤ ዓይን አላቸው፤ ግን አያዩም።
am.B: አፍ አላቸው፤ ምንም አይናገሩም፤ ዓይን አላቸው፤ ምንም አያዩም።
am.R: ጣዖታት አፍ አላቸው፤ መናገር ግን አይችሉም። ዓይን አላቸው፤ ማየት ግን አይችሉም።

hi.L: उनके मुँह है, पर वे बोलती नहीं; उनके आँखें हैं, पर वे देखती नहीं।
hi.B: उनके मुँह तो है, पर वे कुछ नहीं कहतीं; आँखें तो हैं, पर वे कुछ नहीं देखतीं।
hi.R: मूर्तियों के मुँह हैं, पर वे बोल नहीं सकतीं। उनकी आँखें हैं, पर वे देख नहीं सकतीं।

ru.L: У них есть рот, но они не говорят; у них есть глаза, но они не видят.
ru.B: У них есть рот, но они ничего не говорят; у них есть глаза, но они ничего не видят.
ru.R: У идолов есть рот, но они не могут говорить. У них есть глаза, но они не могут видеть.

ja.L: それらには口があるが、語らない。目があるが、見ない。
ja.B: 口があっても、何も言わない。目があっても、何も見ない。
ja.R: 偶像には口があるが、話すことができない。目があるが、見ることができない。

uk.L: Рот у них є, але вони не говорять; очі в них є, але вони не бачать.
uk.B: Мають рот, а нічого не кажуть; мають очі, а нічого не бачать.
uk.R: Ідоли мають роти, але не можуть говорити. Вони мають очі, але не можуть бачити.

decisions.choice: a mouth is to them: they have a mouth
decisions.reason: Hebrew says "to them [is] a mouth" for "they have a mouth". The idols have the shape of a mouth and eyes, but none of their use (115:5).

decisions.choice: Word for word as 115:5 at each level
decisions.reason: The Hebrew of 135:16 is the same as 115:5.

source.text: אָזְנַ֣יִם לָ֭הֶם וְלֹ֣א יַאֲזִ֑ינוּ אַ֝֗ף אֵין־יֶשׁ־ר֥וּחַ בְּפִיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Ears [are] to them, and not they give ear; also there is not breath in their mouth.

en.L: They have ears, but they do not give ear; nor is there any breath in their mouth.
en.B: They have ears, yet hear nothing; there is not even breath in their mouths.
en.R: They have ears, but they cannot hear. They do not even breathe.

fr.L: Elles ont des oreilles, mais elles n’écoutent pas ; il n’y a pas non plus de souffle dans leur bouche.
fr.B: Elles ont des oreilles, et pourtant elles n’entendent rien ; il n’y a même pas de souffle dans leur bouche.
fr.R: Elles ont des oreilles, mais elles ne peuvent pas entendre. Elles ne respirent même pas.

sw.L: Masikio zinayo, lakini hazitegi sikio; wala hakuna pumzi vinywani mwao.
sw.B: Zina masikio, lakini hazisikii kitu; hata pumzi haimo vinywani mwao.
sw.R: Zina masikio, lakini haziwezi kusikia. Hazipumui hata kidogo.

es.L: Tienen oídos, pero no escuchan; ni hay aliento en su boca.
es.B: Tienen oídos, y no oyen nada; ni siquiera hay aliento en su boca.
es.R: Tienen oídos, pero no pueden oír. Ni siquiera respiran.

vi.L: Chúng có tai, nhưng không nghe; trong miệng chúng cũng không có hơi thở.
vi.B: Chúng có tai mà chẳng nghe gì; ngay cả hơi thở cũng không có trong miệng chúng.
vi.R: Chúng có tai nhưng không thể nghe. Chúng thậm chí không thở được.

ko.L: 그것들에게 귀가 있어도 귀 기울이지 못하고, 그것들의 입에는 숨도 없다.
ko.B: 귀가 있어도 아무것도 듣지 못하고, 그 입에는 숨조차 없다.
ko.R: 귀가 있지만 들을 수 없다. 숨도 쉬지 못한다.

pt.L: Têm ouvidos, mas não dão ouvidos; nem sequer há fôlego na sua boca.
pt.B: Têm ouvidos, mas nada ouvem; não há nem fôlego na sua boca.
pt.R: Têm ouvidos, mas não conseguem ouvir. Nem sequer respiram.

am.L: ጆሮ አላቸው፤ ግን አያደምጡም፤ በአፋቸውም እስትንፋስ የለም።
am.B: ጆሮ አላቸው፤ ምንም አይሰሙም፤ በአፋቸው ውስጥ እስትንፋስ እንኳ የለም።
am.R: ጆሮ አላቸው፤ መስማት ግን አይችሉም። ትንፋሽ እንኳ የላቸውም።

hi.L: उनके कान हैं, पर वे कान नहीं लगातीं; न उनके मुँह में कोई साँस है।
hi.B: कान तो हैं, पर वे कुछ नहीं सुनतीं; उनके मुँह में साँस तक नहीं।
hi.R: उनके कान हैं, पर वे सुन नहीं सकतीं। वे साँस तक नहीं लेतीं।

ru.L: У них есть уши, но они не слышат; нет и дыхания в устах их.
ru.B: У них есть уши, но они ничего не слышат; нет даже дыхания в их устах.
ru.R: У них есть уши, но они не могут слышать. Они даже не дышат.

ja.L: それらには耳があるが、耳を傾けない。その口には、息もない。
ja.B: 耳があっても、何も聞かない。その口には、息さえない。
ja.R: 耳があるが、聞くことができない。息をすることさえない。

uk.L: Вуха в них є, але вони не слухають; і немає подиху в їхніх устах.
uk.B: Мають вуха, а нічого не чують; навіть подиху немає в їхніх устах.
uk.R: Вони мають вуха, але не можуть чути. Вони навіть не дихають.

decisions.choice: breath: the breath of life
decisions.reason: The word (ruach) is breath, wind or spirit. An idol has a mouth but no breath, no life at all (Jeremiah 10:14; Habakkuk 2:19). Psalm 115:6 says instead that they cannot smell.

decisions.choice: also there is not: not even
decisions.reason: The words (af 'en yesh) stress the denial: not even breath.

decisions.choice: "कान नहीं लगातीं" (L); "साँस तक नहीं" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The first half keeps the wording of 115:6 except at Literal, where the Hebrew has "give ear" (ya'azinu) for 115:6's "hear", so the Hindi says "कान नहीं लगातीं". The second half has no match in Psalm 115: in place of the nose that cannot smell it says there is no breath in their mouths (m1).

decisions.choice: The first half as 115:6a, with ya'azinu "耳を傾けない" at L (115:6 yishma'u 聞かない); the second half new: 'af 'ein-yesh-ruach befihem "その口には、息もない" (L), "息さえない" (B), "息をすることさえない" (R)
decisions.reason: 135:17b differs from 115:6b (noses) in the Hebrew; the breath is the breath of life (m1), "not even" (m2).

source.text: כְּ֭מוֹהֶם יִהְי֣וּ עֹשֵׂיהֶ֑ם כֹּ֭ל אֲשֶׁר־בֹּטֵ֣חַ בָּהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Like them will be those who make them, everyone who trusts in them.

en.L: Like them will be those who make them, everyone who trusts in them.
en.B: The people who make them will end up like them, and so will everyone who relies on them.
en.R: People who make idols will become as useless as the idols are, and so will everyone who trusts in them.

fr.L: Comme elles seront ceux qui les font, quiconque se confie en elles.
fr.B: Ceux qui les fabriquent finiront comme elles, et de même tous ceux qui comptent sur elles.
fr.R: Les gens qui fabriquent des idoles deviendront aussi inutiles qu’elles, et tous ceux qui ont confiance en elles aussi.

sw.L: Kama hizo watakuwa wale wanaozifanya, kila anayeziamini.
sw.B: Watu wanaozitengeneza wataishia kuwa kama hizo, vivyo hivyo kila anayezitegemea.
sw.R: Watu wanaotengeneza sanamu watakuwa bure kama sanamu hizo, vivyo hivyo kila mtu anayezitumainia.

es.L: Como ellos serán los que los hacen, todo el que confía en ellos.
es.B: Los que los fabrican terminarán como ellos, y también todo el que se apoya en ellos.
es.R: La gente que hace ídolos se volverá tan inútil como los ídolos, y también todo el que confía en ellos.

vi.L: Những kẻ làm ra chúng sẽ giống như chúng, mọi kẻ tin cậy nơi chúng [cũng vậy].
vi.B: Những kẻ làm ra chúng rồi sẽ giống như chúng, và mọi kẻ nương cậy chúng cũng vậy.
vi.R: Những kẻ làm ra thần tượng sẽ trở nên vô dụng như thần tượng, và mọi kẻ tin cậy chúng cũng vậy.

ko.L: 그것들을 만드는 자들, 그것들을 신뢰하는 모든 자가 그것들과 같을 것이다.
ko.B: 그것들을 만드는 사람들은 결국 그것들과 같아질 것이고, 그것들을 의지하는 사람도 모두 그러할 것이다.
ko.R: 우상을 만드는 사람들은 우상처럼 쓸모없게 될 것이다. 우상을 믿는 사람도 모두 그렇게 될 것이다.

pt.L: Como eles serão os que os fazem, todo aquele que neles confia.
pt.B: Os que os fazem vão acabar como eles, e também todos os que confiam neles.
pt.R: As pessoas que fazem ídolos vão ficar tão inúteis quanto os ídolos, e também todos os que confiam neles.

am.L: የሚሠሯቸው፣ በእነርሱም የሚታመን ሁሉ እንደ እነርሱ ይሆናሉ።
am.B: የሚሠሯቸው ሰዎች እንደ እነርሱ ይሆናሉ፤ በእነርሱም የሚመካ ሁሉ እንዲሁ።
am.R: ጣዖታትን የሚሠሩ ሰዎች እንደ ጣዖታቱ የማይጠቅሙ ይሆናሉ፤ በእነርሱ የሚታመኑም ሁሉ እንዲሁ።

hi.L: उनके बनानेवाले उन्हीं के समान हो जाएँगे, और हर एक जो उन पर भरोसा रखता है।
hi.B: जो लोग उन्हें बनाते हैं, वे उन्हीं के जैसे हो जाएँगे, और वे सब भी जो उन पर भरोसा रखते हैं।
hi.R: जो लोग मूर्तियाँ बनाते हैं, वे भी उन मूर्तियों जैसे ही बेकार हो जाएँगे, और वे सब भी जो उन पर भरोसा करते हैं।

ru.L: Подобны им будут делающие их, всякий, кто надеется на них.
ru.B: Люди, которые их делают, станут такими же, как они, и все, кто полагается на них.
ru.R: Люди, которые делают идолов, станут такими же бесполезными, как идолы, и все, кто надеется на них.

ja.L: それらと同じようになる、それらを造る者たち、それらに信頼する者はみな。
ja.B: それらを造る者たちは、それらと同じようになり、それらに頼る者もみな、そうなる。
ja.R: 偶像を作る人たちは、偶像と同じように役に立たない者になる。偶像に頼る人たちも、みなそうなる。

uk.L: Подібні до них будуть ті, хто їх робить, кожен, хто покладається на них.
uk.B: Люди, що їх роблять, стануть такими, як вони, і так само кожен, хто на них покладається.
uk.R: Люди, які роблять ідолів, стануть такими ж нікчемними, як ідоли, і так само кожен, хто на них надіється.

decisions.choice: will be: a statement, or a wish
alternatives: may those who make them be like them
decisions.reason: The verb can say what will happen or what the singer wishes. As in 115:8, it is taken as a statement of what becomes of idol makers.

decisions.choice: people become like what they worship
decisions.reason: Those who trust in lifeless things become lifeless and deaf to God themselves (Isaiah 44:9-20; Jeremiah 2:5).

decisions.choice: as useless as the idols are
decisions.reason: Readable says in what way they become like the idols (m2).

decisions.choice: Word for word as 115:8 at each level: yihyu "同じようになる" as a statement
decisions.reason: The Hebrew of 135:18 is the same as 115:8; statement or wish is uncertain (m1).

source.text: בֵּ֣ית יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל בָּרֲכ֣וּ אֶת־יְהוָ֑ה בֵּ֥ית אַ֝הֲרֹ֗ן בָּרֲכ֥וּ אֶת־יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: House of Israel, bless YHWH; house of Aaron, bless YHWH.

en.L: House of Israel, bless {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; house of Aaron, bless {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: People of Israel, bless {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! Family of Aaron, bless {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}!
en.R: People of Israel, praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! Priests of Aaron's family, praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}!

fr.L: Maison d’Israël, bénissez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; maison d’Aaron, bénissez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Peuple d’Israël, bénissez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ! Famille d’Aaron, bénissez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} !
fr.R: Peuple d’Israël, louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ! Prêtres de la famille d’Aaron, louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} !

sw.L: Enyi nyumba ya Israeli, mbarikini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; enyi nyumba ya Haruni, mbarikini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Enyi watu wa Israeli, mbarikini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! Enyi jamaa ya Haruni, mbarikini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}!
sw.R: Watu wa Israeli, msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! Makuhani wa ukoo wa Haruni, msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}!

es.L: Casa de Israel, {{plural_you:bendigan|bendecid}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}; casa de Aarón, {{plural_you:bendigan|bendecid}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.B: Pueblo de Israel, ¡{{plural_you:bendigan|bendecid}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}! Familia de Aarón, ¡{{plural_you:bendigan|bendecid}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}!
es.R: Pueblo de Israel, ¡{{plural_you:alaben|alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}! Sacerdotes de la familia de Aarón, ¡{{plural_you:alaben|alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}!

vi.L: Hỡi nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên, hãy chúc tụng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; hỡi nhà A-rôn, hãy chúc tụng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Hỡi dân Y-sơ-ra-ên, hãy chúc tụng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! Hỡi gia tộc A-rôn, hãy chúc tụng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}!
vi.R: Hỡi dân Y-sơ-ra-ên, hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! Hỡi các thầy tế lễ thuộc dòng họ A-rôn, hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}!

ko.L: 이스라엘의 집아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 송축하여라. 아론의 집아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 송축하여라.
ko.B: 이스라엘 백성아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 송축하여라! 아론의 가문아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 송축하여라!
ko.R: 이스라엘 백성아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찬양하여라! 아론 집안의 제사장들아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찬양하여라!

pt.L: Casa de Israel, bendigam {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}; casa de Arão, bendigam {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.B: Povo de Israel, bendigam {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}! Família de Arão, bendigam {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}!
pt.R: Povo de Israel, louvem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}! Sacerdotes da família de Arão, louvem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}!

am.L: የእስራኤል ቤት ሆይ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ባርኩ፤ የአሮን ቤት ሆይ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ባርኩ።
am.B: የእስራኤል ሕዝብ ሆይ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ባርኩ! የአሮን ቤተሰብ ሆይ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ባርኩ!
am.R: የእስራኤል ሕዝብ ሆይ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} አመስግኑ! ከአሮን ቤተሰብ የሆናችሁ ካህናት ሆይ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} አመስግኑ!

hi.L: हे इस्राएल के घराने, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को धन्य कहो; हे हारून के घराने, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को धन्य कहो।
hi.B: हे इस्राएल के लोगो, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को धन्य कहो! हे हारून के परिवार, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को धन्य कहो!
hi.R: हे इस्राएल के लोगो, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की स्तुति करो! हे हारून के परिवार के याजको, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की स्तुति करो!

ru.L: Дом Израиля, благословите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}; дом Аарона, благословите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.B: Народ Израиля, благословите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}! Род Аарона, благословите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}!
ru.R: Народ Израиля, хвалите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}! Священники из рода Аарона, хвалите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}!

ja.L: イスラエルの家よ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}をほめたたえよ。アロンの家よ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}をほめたたえよ。
ja.B: イスラエルの民よ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}をほめたたえよ！アロンの家よ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}をほめたたえよ！
ja.R: イスラエルの人々よ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}をほめたたえよう！アロンの家族の祭司たちよ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}をほめたたえよう！

uk.L: Доме Ізраїля, благословляйте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}; доме Аарона, благословляйте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}.
uk.B: Народе Ізраїлю, благословляй {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}! Родино Аарона, благословляй {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}!
uk.R: Народе Ізраїлю, хвали {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}! Священники з родини Аарона, хваліть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}!

decisions.choice: Israel, Aaron, those who fear: as in 115 and 118
decisions.reason: The same groups are called on in 115:9-11 and 118:2-4. This psalm adds the house of Levi (verse 20).

decisions.choice: house of Aaron: the priests
decisions.reason: The priests were Aaron's descendants (Exodus 28:1).

decisions.choice: bless the LORD: praise him, speak well of him
decisions.reason: When people bless God (barakh), they praise him and give him thanks; when God blesses people, he gives them good.

decisions.choice: praise
decisions.reason: Readable says "praise", the sense of blessing God (m3).

decisions.choice: благословите (L, B); хвалите (R)
decisions.reason: As in 134:1: blessing the LORD is благословлять, and Readable says хвалите (m3).

decisions.choice: barekhu "ほめたたえよ" (L, B), "ほめたたえよう" (R); beit Yisra'el / beit 'Aharon "イスラエルの家 / アロンの家" (L), "イスラエルの民 / アロンの家" (B), "イスラエルの人々 / アロンの家族の祭司たち" (R)
decisions.reason: barekh with God as object is ほめたたえる at every level (English R "praise"); the groups as 115:9-11 (m1, m2).

source.text: בֵּ֣ית הַ֭לֵּוִי בָּרֲכ֣וּ אֶת־יְהוָ֑ה יִֽרְאֵ֥י יְ֝הוָ֗ה בָּרֲכ֥וּ אֶת־יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: House of the Levite, bless YHWH; [those] fearing YHWH, bless YHWH.

en.L: House of the Levite, bless {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; [you who] fear {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, bless {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Family of Levi, bless {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! All who fear {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, bless {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}!
en.R: Levites, praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! Everyone who has deep respect for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}!

fr.L: Maison du Lévite, bénissez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; [vous qui] craignez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, bénissez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Famille de Lévi, bénissez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ! Vous tous qui craignez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, bénissez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} !
fr.R: Lévites, louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ! Vous tous qui honorez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avec respect, louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} !

sw.L: Enyi nyumba ya Lawi, mbarikini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; [ninyi] mnaomcha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mbarikini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Enyi jamaa ya Lawi, mbarikini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! Ninyi nyote mnaomcha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mbarikini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}!
sw.R: Walawi, msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! Kila mmoja anayemheshimu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa hofu takatifu, msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}!

es.L: Casa del levita, {{plural_you:bendigan|bendecid}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}; [los que] temen {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, {{plural_you:bendigan|bendecid}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.B: Familia de Leví, ¡{{plural_you:bendigan|bendecid}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}! Todos los que temen {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, ¡{{plural_you:bendigan|bendecid}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}!
es.R: Levitas, ¡{{plural_you:alaben|alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}! Todos los que sienten profundo respeto por {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ¡{{plural_you:alaben|alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}!

vi.L: Hỡi nhà Lê-vi, hãy chúc tụng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; [hỡi những người] kính sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, hãy chúc tụng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Hỡi gia tộc Lê-vi, hãy chúc tụng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! Hỡi tất cả những ai kính sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, hãy chúc tụng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}!
vi.R: Hỡi người Lê-vi, hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! Hỡi tất cả những ai hết lòng tôn kính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}!

ko.L: 레위의 집아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 송축하여라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 경외하는 자들아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 송축하여라.
ko.B: 레위 가문아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 송축하여라! {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 경외하는 모든 이들아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 송축하여라!
ko.R: 레위 사람들아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찬양하여라! {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 두려운 마음으로 섬기는 사람들아, 모두 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찬양하여라!

pt.L: Casa do levita, bendigam {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}; [vocês que] temem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, bendigam {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.B: Família de Levi, bendigam {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}! Todos os que temem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, bendigam {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}!
pt.R: Levitas, louvem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}! Todos vocês que respeitam profundamente {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, louvem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}!

am.L: የሌዊ ቤት ሆይ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ባርኩ፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} የምትፈሩ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ባርኩ።
am.B: የሌዊ ቤተሰብ ሆይ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ባርኩ! {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} የምትፈሩ ሁሉ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ባርኩ!
am.R: ሌዋውያን ሆይ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} አመስግኑ! {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} በጥልቅ የምታከብሩ ሁሉ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} አመስግኑ!

hi.L: हे लेवी के घराने, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को धन्य कहो; [हे] {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का भय माननेवालो, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को धन्य कहो।
hi.B: हे लेवी के परिवार, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को धन्य कहो! हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का भय माननेवाले सब लोगो, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को धन्य कहो!
hi.R: हे लेवियो, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की स्तुति करो! हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का आदर और भय माननेवाले सब लोगो, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की स्तुति करो!

ru.L: Дом Левия, благословите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}; боящиеся {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, благословите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.B: Род Левия, благословите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}! Все, кто боится {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, благословите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}!
ru.R: Левиты, хвалите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}! Все, кто почитает {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, хвалите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}!

ja.L: レビの家よ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}をほめたたえよ。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を恐れる者たちよ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}をほめたたえよ。
ja.B: レビの一族よ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}をほめたたえよ！{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を畏れる者たちよ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}をほめたたえよ！
ja.R: レビ人たちよ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}をほめたたえよう！{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}をおそれ敬うすべての人たちよ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}をほめたたえよう！

uk.L: Доме Левія, благословляйте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}; [ви, що] боїтеся {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, благословляйте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}.
uk.B: Родино Левія, благословляй {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}! Усі, хто боїться {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, благословляйте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}!
uk.R: Левити, хваліть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}! Кожен, хто глибоко шанує {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, хваліть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}!

decisions.choice: house of the Levite: the Levites
decisions.reason: The tribe of Levi served at the temple under the priests (Numbers 3:5-9), as singers, gatekeepers and helpers (1 Chronicles 23:28-32).

decisions.choice: those who fear the LORD: his worshipers
decisions.reason: Those who fear the LORD are all who honor and obey him (15:4; 22:24). After Israel, the priests and the Levites, the call may also reach worshipers from other nations.

decisions.choice: who has deep respect for
decisions.reason: Readable gives the sense of "fear" here: reverence, not terror.

decisions.choice: beit hallevi "レビの家" (L), "レビの一族" (B), "レビ人たち" (R); yir'ei YHWH "DNを恐れる者たち" (L), "畏れる者たち" (B), "おそれ敬うすべての人たち" (R)
decisions.reason: As 115:11; the house of the Levite is the Levites (m1).

source.text: בָּ֘ר֤וּךְ יְהוָ֨ה׀מִצִּיּ֗וֹן שֹׁ֘כֵ֤ן יְֽרוּשָׁלִָ֗ם הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Blessed [be] YHWH from Zion, dwelling [in] Jerusalem. Praise Yah!

en.L: Blessed [be] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} from Zion, [{{deity_pronoun:he|He}} who] dwells [in] Jerusalem. Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}!
en.B: May {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} be blessed from Zion, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} who lives in Jerusalem. Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}!
en.R: Let praise rise to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} from Zion, to the God who lives in Jerusalem. Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}!

fr.L: Béni [soit] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} depuis Sion, [{{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui] demeure [à] Jérusalem ! Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} !
fr.B: Que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} soit béni depuis Sion, {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui habite à Jérusalem ! Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} !
fr.R: Que la louange monte vers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} depuis Sion, vers le Dieu qui habite à Jérusalem ! Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} !

sw.L: Na abarikiwe {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kutoka Sayuni, [{{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}] akaaye [katika] Yerusalemu. Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}!
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na abarikiwe kutoka Sayuni, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} anayeishi Yerusalemu. Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}!
sw.R: Sifa na zimpandie {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kutoka Sayuni, Mungu anayeishi Yerusalemu. Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}!

es.L: Bendito [sea] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} desde Sion, [el que] habita [en] Jerusalén. ¡{{plural_you:Alaben|Alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yah}}!
es.B: Que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} sea bendecido desde Sion, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, que vive en Jerusalén. ¡{{plural_you:Alaben|Alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yah}}!
es.R: Que suba la alabanza {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} desde Sion, al Dios que vive en Jerusalén. ¡{{plural_you:Alaben|Alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yah}}!

vi.L: Chúc tụng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} từ Si-ôn, [Đấng] ngự [tại] Giê-ru-sa-lem. Hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}}!
vi.B: Nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} được chúc tụng từ Si-ôn, là Đấng ngự tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}}!
vi.R: Hãy để lời ca ngợi dâng lên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} từ Si-ôn, dâng lên Đức Chúa Trời là Đấng ngự tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}}!

ko.L: 시온에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 송축을 받으시기를, 예루살렘에 거하시는 [분께서]. {{divine_name:주|야}}를 찬양하여라!
ko.B: 예루살렘에 사시는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 시온에서 송축을 받으시기를! {{divine_name:주|야}}를 찬양하여라!
ko.R: 예루살렘에 계시는 하나님, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 시온에서 찬양이 울려 퍼지기를! {{divine_name:주|야}}를 찬양하여라!

pt.L: Bendito [seja] {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} desde Sião, [{{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} que] habita [em] Jerusalém. Aleluia!
pt.B: Que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} seja bendito desde Sião, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} que mora em Jerusalém. Aleluia!
pt.R: Que o louvor suba {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} desde Sião, ao Deus que mora em Jerusalém. Louvem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Iá}}!

am.L: በኢየሩሳሌም የሚኖር {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከጽዮን ይባረክ። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህን}} አመስግኑ!
am.B: በኢየሩሳሌም የሚኖረው {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከጽዮን ይባረክ። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህን}} አመስግኑ!
am.R: በኢየሩሳሌም ለሚኖረው አምላክ፣ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}}፣ ከጽዮን ምስጋና ይድረሰው። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህን}} አመስግኑ!

hi.L: सिय्योन से {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} धन्य [हों], [वे जो] यरूशलेम में वास करते हैं। {{divine_name:प्रभु|याह}} की स्तुति करो!
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} सिय्योन से धन्य कहे जाएँ, वे जो यरूशलेम में रहते हैं। {{divine_name:प्रभु|याह}} की स्तुति करो!
hi.R: सिय्योन से {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की स्तुति हो, उस परमेश्वर की जो यरूशलेम में रहते हैं। {{divine_name:प्रभु|याह}} की स्तुति करो!

ru.L: Благословен {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} с Сиона, [{{deity_pronoun:он|Он}}, который] обитает [в] Иерусалиме. Хвалите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ях}}!
ru.B: Да будет благословен {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} с Сиона, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}}, живущий в Иерусалиме. Хвалите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ях}}!
ru.R: Пусть с Сиона возносится хвала {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, Богу, который живёт в Иерусалиме. Хвалите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ях}}!

ja.L: シオンから、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はほめたたえられよ、エルサレムにお住まいになる方は。{{divine_name:主|ヤハ}}を賛美せよ！
ja.B: エルサレムにお住まいになる{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が、シオンからほめたたえられるように。{{divine_name:主|ヤハ}}を賛美せよ！
ja.R: エルサレムに住んでおられる神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を、シオンからほめたたえよう！{{divine_name:主|ヤハ}}を賛美しよう！

uk.L: Благословенний {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} із Сіону, [той, хто] живе [в] Єрусалимі. Хваліть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яг}}!
uk.B: Нехай {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} буде благословенний із Сіону, {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}}, що живе в Єрусалимі. Хваліть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яг}}!
uk.R: Нехай хвала підноситься до {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} із Сіону, до Бога, що живе в Єрусалимі. Хваліть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яг}}!

decisions.choice: from Zion: praise rising from where God lives
decisions.reason: In 134:3 the LORD blesses his people from Zion; here his people bless him from Zion. The God of all the earth (verses 5-7) has chosen to live among his people in Jerusalem (132:13-14).

decisions.choice: Praise Yah: the call Hallelu-yah
decisions.reason: As in verse 1; the psalm ends as it began.

decisions.choice: Let praise rise to
decisions.reason: Readable says what it means to bless God (verse 19).

decisions.choice: barukh YHWH "ほめたたえられよ" (L), "ほめたたえられるように" (B), "ほめたたえよう" (R); shokhen "お住まいになる" (L, B), "住んでおられる" (R)
decisions.reason: Psalter forms for barukh and Hallelu-yah; お住まいになる avoids 住まわれる.
